description.value: We examined regional responses in 20 cocaine-dependent and 24 healthy control participants exposed to cocaine/food and neutral cues during functional magnetic resonance imaging, including cue-related activation, clinical correlations, and mediation analyses.

spans.text: We examined regional responses in 20 cocaine-dependent and 24 healthy control participants exposed to cocaine/food (cocaine dependent) and food (healthy control) vs neutral cues during functional magnetic resonance imaging.

description.value: The study was cross-sectional and included cocaine-dependent participants and matched healthy controls; cocaine-dependent participants completed both the cue-induced cocaine craving task and cue-induced food craving task, while healthy controls completed the food craving task.

spans.text: In the current study, we examined cue-elicited brain activations in a new sample of 20 CDs engaged in both cocaine craving and food craving tasks and 24 HC matched in demographics and body mass index (BMI) in the food craving task.
